PA R T A · S TA R T H E R E

Welcome, Thinking Paleontologist

Read the six-chapter JE story assigned to each unit. Quote exactly, cite the chapter, name a warrant, test
counter-evidence and mark uncertainty. This workbook follows the Teacher Pack one lesson at a time. All
stories are separate original JE Storybook Workbooks; no published novel is required.
